sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ramesh Chandra Pandey Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
Applicant has approached this Court through this application under Section 483 Code of Criminal Procedure for issuance of directions to the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Azamgarh to expedite and conclude the proceedings of Case No. 583 of 1997, titled State Vs. RAmesh Chandra Pandey, under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station Phoolpur,
District Azamgarh, in a stipulated period.
Concededly, the accused-applicant has been extended the concession of bail vide order dated 17.9.2023.
The above background shows that delay, if any, in conclusion of trial is attributed to the accused himself.
The application fails and is hereby dismissed.
